detail: 12-byte header + raw RGBA8/RGB565 pixels, FNV-1a disk_key, skips PNG re-decode, RGB565 cuts VRAM 50%

detail: Launch push_front, metadata push_back, HashSet<(uri,payload)> dedup, Condvar signaling

title: rustfmt.toml: style_edition 2021 pin
detail: Fixes Edition 2024 RFC 3407 import-sorting CI failures (3 consecutive runs)

detail: luma labs --module <name> --bench, luma benchmark --module <name>, luma review --all

detail: Sandbox has no rustc binary — compile correctness must be verified on CI/TV build agent. Run cargo test (default features) and cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings to confirm zero warnings.

title: Full labs measurement: run all lab_command modules
detail: Run luma labs --module motion --bench, navigation, texture, platform, nuvio to capture Spring1D convergence, focus corridor, upload budget, LS2 deque, and LCKV bridge metrics.

title: Update docs for Nuvio Stacks Options integration and cross-repo contract
detail: Update docs/ARCHITECTURE-PHASE2-NIVIO-CONTINUE-WATCHING.md, docs/MEASUREMENT.md, docs/INTEGRATION-AUDIT.md with Metahub CDN URLs, LCKV layout, connection badge, progress bar, and zero-config default row.

title: Memory store: register cross-repo Nuvio contract constants
detail: Store NUVIO_APP_ID, deep-link scheme, bridge path, LCKV layout, Metahub CDN URLs, and seqlock invariant in .agent-memory/memories.db namespace=nuvio-contract for cross-agent clarity.

title: Forensic review: verify all 7 council findings (V-01 to V-07) are resolved
detail: Verify V-01 (match-arm syntax), V-02 (shader attr contract), V-03 (zero-raiser variants), V-04 (default features/serde), V-05 (app ID/deep-link), V-06 (Metahub domain), V-07 (LCKV header) are all resolved in source.

title: Reverse-engineering: verify paint.vert NDC contract matches QuadBatcher output
detail: Verify gl_Position = a_position.x/960 - 1, 1 - a_position.y/540 matches push_rounded_quad screen-space pixel coordinates (no double-transform). Confirm 5-attribute stride = 56 bytes matches paint.vert.

title: LCKV strict parser + FNV-1a constants
detail: fast_kv.rs: MAX_BRIDGE_CARDS=40, MAX_BRIDGE_BYTES=16384, exact length validation, count limit, progress_permille <= 1000 check, unpack_fixed_str returns io::Result with UTF-8 validation, FNV-1a hash constants verified (continue-watching=0x01aa2aebbc61d6f6, watchlist=0x5bb28e17f2144504, library=0x064f786c25b1670c), 9 new unit tests

title: Unique StackItem.id per card
detail: nuvio.rs: unique_card_id() derives i64 from fnv1a_64(card_id) ^ fnv1a_64(content_target).rotate_left(13) + seq, keeping strictly positive. Replaces collection_hash as i64 which collided across all cards in a collection.

title: Background video crash fix - VRAM shedding + occlusion guard
detail: renderer.rs: shed_replaceable_vram() drains textures (gl::DeleteTextures via Drop), clears upload queue, gl::Flush(), malloc_trim(0). main.rs: is_backgrounded flag via SDL WindowEvent Hidden/Minimized/FocusLost/AppLowMemory/AppDidEnterBackground + AppWillEnterForeground; render+swap guarded with !is_backgrounded; shed on occlusion, restore on foreground.

title: Update docs for background video survival + cross-repo contract
detail: Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/MEASUREMENT.md, docs/INTEGRATION-AUDIT.md with VRAM shedding, memorymanager physics (CMA/DPB ~186MB for 4K HEVC), FNV-1a constants, LCKV layout, empty-bridge semantics, unique identity. Register cross-repo Nuvio contract constants.

title: Fix P0 Bug 1: extra } in src/nuvio.rs
detail: Removed stray closing brace after unique_card_id() that caused hard parse error. Removed seq parameter from unique_card_id() — card IDs now derived only from card_id + content_target (position-independent). Removed unused .enumerate() from map closure.

title: Fix P0 Bug 2: shed_replaceable_vram() outside impl Renderer
detail: Removed pub fn shed_replaceable_vram(&mut self) from module scope in src/renderer.rs — self parameter only valid in associated functions. Function also called self.textures.clear() destroying all textures.

title: Fix P0 Bug 3: labs --module nuvio writes to default_bridge_path()
detail: Changed labs --module nuvio to write to PID-scoped temp fixture in temp dir, verify round-trip read, then self-delete. Never touches /tmp/nuvio_stacks.lckv.

title: Fix self-inflicted FocusLost texture shedding regression
detail: Removed is_backgrounded flag, all renderer.shed_replaceable_vram() calls, and render guard from src/main.rs. FocusLost/AppLowMemory no longer freeze render or destroy textures — only Hidden/Minimized set visible=false (pre-existing).

title: Fix P1 Bug 5: LCKV contract drift (MAX_BRIDGE_CARDS, tests, seq==0)
detail: Added MAX_BRIDGE_CARDS enforcement to write_bridge_cards(). Rewrote all negative unit tests to use write_bridge_cards() + mutate exact byte offsets. Added tests for seq==0 (valid), odd seq (reject), torn seq (reject), invalid progress_permille (reject), invalid UTF-8 slot (reject).

title: Upgrade scripts/sandbox_verify.py with 4 missing checks
detail: Added: (1) brace/paren/bracket balance per file with comment+string stripping (handles raw/byte/char literals), (2) module-scope &self/&mut self detector at brace depth 0, (3) strict 100-col width check including lines with string arguments. These catch P0 compiler errors and rustfmt failures that sandbox_verify previously missed.
